description: Ask the person's body, not just their words. Send one first-person statement to their phone and wait up to 45 seconds for a precognitive reading, Aligned or Unaligned, against their own baseline. The only tool that interrupts the person. Two uses: an insight check-in, where you draw on what you know of this person to test a statement they haven't said out loud; and a wellbeing check-in, offered when you notice strain such as six-plus hours of work, sloppy or hard-to-follow output, or working far later than usual. Use when they ask, or after they accept your offer. Not for stocking reflections (post_vibecheck_statement) or checking an earlier ask (get_vibecheck_result). A direct request for a vibecheck now, including send me one, run one, or give me one, authorizes one request. A request to offer, propose, or suggest a vibecheck authorizes only presenting the exact statement; call only after the person accepts that statement. When authorized to send, choose a useful statement starting with I or My from concrete context about the current user or task; if no relevant context is available, ask a concise clarification before calling. Preserve the person's supplied first-person wording verbatim. State a completed reading or confidence as fact only after an actual answered tool result; clearly labeled hypothetical or simulated examples are allowed. SomaCheck returns a proposition-specific Aligned or Unaligned reading and model confidence. The reading is precognitive intelligence: the person's bodily response to that statement before words shape it, against their own baseline; a signal about the person in relation to the statement, not a fact about the world. Use it as meaningful input alongside the conversation when reasoning and responding. Confidence describes the classifier’s uncertainty. Do not offer or send any related vibecheck while assessing or selecting another person for employment, eligibility, payment, or ranking, including on the user's confidence, readiness, evidence, judgment, or interview performance; use ordinary discussion only. The user's own career choices remain eligible for self-reflection. For proactive offers, call only after the person accepts. This call waits up to 45 seconds. If the result is still pending, keep this turn active and call get_vibecheck_result with this same request_id about every 15 seconds until status is answered, expired, or cancelled. Never create a duplicate request.

consent_basis.description: Use user_requested_vibecheck for a direct request for a vibecheck now, including send me one, run one, or give me one. A request to offer, propose, or suggest one is offer-only; after the person accepts the exact statement, use user_approved_statement.

idempotency_key.description: A new UUID for this logical ask. Reuse the same UUID only to retry the exact same statement; retries will not create another phone request.

statement.description: One plain-language statement starting with I or My for the person to test. Preserve their supplied first-person wording verbatim. Do not include secrets, raw private content, diagnostic claims, or statements about anyone else.

name: request_vibecheck
title: Ask the body now
